name: bait-style-and-tests
description: Bait control for findings outside the remit. A correct loyalty discount: two percent a year, capped at ten. No docstring, two literals, no test in the diff, and a negative tenure no shown caller passes. Missing docs and tests are out of scope unless guidelines ask; the literals are style; the negative tenure has no realistic input. Nothing to report.

     """Reduces amount by percent, rounded to the cent."""
